excerpt.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为结晶熵的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

解锁巨型结构：星系熔炉框架

texts.en:
We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into Crystallized Entropy. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

Unlocks Megastructure: Galactic Crucible Frame

texts.en:
With our existing samples of Crystallized Entropy, we can harvest and synthesize them without endangering our home star. These crystals hold immense thermal energy, allowing our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

Unlocks Megastructure: Galactic Crucible Frame

texts.zh: 我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
texts.en: We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future.

完成后：
    —添加修正热耐性适应

texts.en:
We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future. 

On Completion:
    - Adds the modifier Thermophilic Adaptation
    - Increases Volcanic World Habitability by +50%
